register.labelZh: CRACK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: crack down 可以用來描述針對危險、不誠實或不可接受的行為採取強硬措施。；crack on 是常見的英式表達,用來表示不再浪費時間,趕快繼續做事。；crack up 可以表示一個人受到很大壓力,已經無法繼續應付。；crack up 和 crack somebody up 可以表示笑個不停,或令另一個人笑個不停。
register.summaryEn: Crack down helps you describe strong action against dangerous, dishonest or unacceptable behaviour. Crack on is a natural British expression for continuing a task without wasting time. Crack up can express that a person is no longer able to cope with serious pressure. Crack up and crack somebody up help you describe laughing very hard or making another person laugh.
